$description: SajdaTime type scale, release 1.6. Tested against app/src/main/java/com/sajdatime/app/ui/theme/Type.kt (SajdaTypography, PrayerTimeTextStyle) by DesignTokensTest. Sizes are sp on Android and pt on iOS, always scalable with the user's text size. Line heights: about 1.4x for body, about 1.3x for titles (one rule since 17 Oct 2026). Nothing below 14 in the phone app.

fontFamily.android: FontFamily.Default (Roboto, or the font the user chose; Noto Naskh Arabic for Urdu and Arabic comes from the system)
fontFamily.ios: SF Pro (Font.system), never a bundled font
fontFamily.rule: No bundled font. It would add about 400KB and override a font the user chose for accessibility.

displayLarge.usage: The countdown on the next prayer card.

displayMedium.usage: The app name on the setup welcome screen (its one use).

headlineMedium.usage: ScreenTitle, the city on Times, setup step titles, the next prayer name and time on the hero card, the Qibla direction sentence.

headlineSmall.usage: Sheet titles (Timetable, Last 30 days, Islamic dates) and the Bismillah on the welcome screen. AlertDialog titles inherit it.

titleLarge.usage: Location sheet and export sheet titles, setup choice card titles.

titleMedium.usage: Row titles (Settings rows, Islamic dates rows, Timetable day and month headings), notice titles, the Today heading.

bodyMedium.usage: Secondary text: row descriptions, notice briefs, footnotes.

labelLarge.usage: Text links (Close, Got it). With weight 500 (Medium): the section label voice (Settings group titles, the Next prayer label, the week card title, dialog SectionLabel).

labelMedium.usage: Pills (Next, Now, Today), tab labels, the until line, day names, small captions. The floor.

prayerTime.usage: Every time of day in a list (05:14). Tabular so columns never drift. lineHeight unset: inherits the platform default for 18sp.

actionLabel.usage: Every solid button label and the usage question's two bold links. Never 14, never regular weight. A wrapped label is centred.

unsetMaterialRoles.$description: Roles Type.kt does not define, so Material 3 baseline values apply. Three of them ARE used today (census 25 Oct 2026), below the 14 floor: a recorded gap, not a licence. Do not add new uses. The fix (define them in Type.kt or move the uses to bodyMedium and labelMedium) is a visible change for the owner to approve.

uses: SettingsScreen.kt adjustments help x2 and LimitNote

rules: Section labels are sentence case and never uppercased in code (String.uppercase breaks Turkish i and caseless scripts). Quiet Glass retired the letterspaced label: today only the Ramadan card label keeps letterSpacing 1.6 (a leftover, do not copy). A language that wants capitals writes them in its string.
A word is never split across two lines. Short labels in fixed slots (tab bar, theme selector) use WholeWords, which shrinks text to no less than 60% while a break falls inside a word.
Tabular figures make Latin digits even width. Numbers are formatted in the language the words are in; Arabic uses ar-u-nu-latn so digits stay Western.

Widgets size the countdown in dp (34 to 38) because it is already three times body size; names and times stay in sp. Widget floor is 12sp, with two named exceptions that may shrink to 9sp (large Today widget Hijri line, Today strip time at 250dp).
Urdu and Arabic single lines stand about 4dp taller than Latin (Noto Naskh ascent and descent). Known, OPEN item 1.6-script-line-box; do not hard code heights that assume Latin.
Numbers that change in place (countdown, Qibla bearing and distance, prayer times) use tabular figures: tabular styles, PrayerTimeTextStyle, or .copy(fontFeatureSettings = "tnum").
